script_text: Stop! Pisces, the stars are screaming at you right now. Your ruling planet Neptune, modern governor of Pisces and master of illusion, sits in Aries and forms an exact tightening square to the Sun in Cancer. This frictional aspect pulses through your 2nd House of personal resources and your 5th House of romantic creativity, deeply unsettling the usually fluid Water sign rhythm. If you are single, the nebulous 5th House mist attracts a dreamy Pisces-compatible Scorpio; if committed, beware a lover blurring lines around joint savings tonight. Meanwhile, your 10th House of career status receives a bright trine from Mercury in Leo to Neptune, signaling an unsolicited promotion or client referral from a charismatic leader. Unexpected blessing: a stalled royalty payment clears before midnight, flooding your 2nd House with surprise income. Subscribe so you don't miss what's coming this week.
